# WhatEverFi brand

Logos and colors for writing about WhatEverFi.

## Logos

- [Logo](https://whateverfi.com/brand/kit/whateverfi-logo.png): PNG · 1712 × 576
- [Wordmark](https://whateverfi.com/brand/kit/whateverfi-wordmark.svg): SVG
- [App icon](https://whateverfi.com/brand/kit/whateverfi-icon.png): PNG · 1024 × 1024
- [Mascot](https://whateverfi.com/brand/kit/whateverfi-mascot.png): PNG · 700 × 700

## Colors

- Orange: `#F97D16`
- Black: `#141414`
- White: `#FFFFFF`

## Usage

Write WhatEverFi with a capital R in text. The wordmark is lowercase. Do not alter the mascot or imply an endorsement.

For press, email hello@whateverfi.com.
